subject: The 2AM email I never thought I'd send
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but... something changed last night.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. But it's 2AM, I'm sitting here staring at the code that became Loud EQ, and I just had to tell you something raw. This app started as a fix for my own commute—audio so quiet I'd crank my phone to max and still miss every word of my audiobook. That frustration is why I built this, not for a paycheck, but so you never have to strain to hear again.

Tonight, I watched a user's message scroll across my screen. They said they finally heard their kids' voices in a video message for the first time in months, because the road noise was gone, and the dialogue was clear. That hit me. That's why this exists. Not for downloads or ratings, but for the moment when sound just works—loud, clear, and safe for your ears.

You already have the app. The feature that makes that possible is the one-tap Optimize button. Plug in your headphones, hit it, and it tunes around your device instantly. No distortion, no harshness—just +200% volume where you need it. Audio profiles for podcasts, music, movies—it's all there, waiting for you to use.

Open Loud EQ right now. Tap Optimize with your headphones connected. Hear the difference. P.S. I built the hearing-safe streak in here because I care about your ears as much as your sound. Use it once, and you'll see why thousands use it daily.
